arxiv-1801-04242.title: Development of Energy Models for Design Space Exploration of Embedded Many-Core Systems Conference: High Performance Energy Efficient Embedded Systems Workshop; January 2018; Manchester, United Kingdom
arxiv-1801-04242.creator: Christian Klarhorst † , Martin Flasskamp † , Johannes Ax † , Thorsten Jungeblut † , Wayne Kelly * , Mario Porrmann † , and Ulrich Rückert †
arxiv-1801-04242.description: Abstract . This paper introduces a methodology to develop energy models for the design space exploration of embedded many-core systems. The design process of such systems can benefit from sophisticated models. Software and hardware can be specifically optimized based on comprehensive knowledge about application scenario and hardware behavior.

arxiv-2207-07808.title: A Note on the Krein-Rutman Theorem for Sectorial Operators † Journal: arXiv † {\dagger} This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [11871368]
arxiv-2207-07808.creator: Desheng Li, Ruijing Wang, Luyan Zhou
arxiv-2207-07808.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Desheng Li, Ruijing Wang, Luyan Zhou. In this note we present some generalized versions of the Krein-Rutman theorem for sectorial operators. They are formulated in a fashion that can be easily applied to elliptic operators. Another feature of these generalized versions is that they contain some information on the generalized eigenspaces associated with non-principal eigenvalues, which are helpful in the study of the dynamics of evolution equations in ordered Banach spaces. 2020 MSC 35P05, 47B65, 47A75.

arxiv-2402-12690.title: Simpson’s Paradox and the Accuracy-Fluency Tradeoff in Translation
arxiv-2402-12690.creator: Zheng Wei Lim, Ekaterina Vylomova, Trevor Cohn, Charles Kemp
arxiv-2402-12690.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zheng Wei Lim, Ekaterina Vylomova, Trevor Cohn, Charles Kemp. A good translation should be faithful to the source and should respect the norms of the target language. We address a theoretical puzzle about the relationship between these objectives. On one hand, intuition and some prior work suggest that accuracy and fluency should trade off against each other, and that capturing every detail of the source can only be achieved at the cost of fluency.

arxiv-2410-23556.title: Language-guided Hierarchical Fine-grained Image Forgery Detection and Localization
arxiv-2410-23556.creator: Xiao Guo, Xiaohong Liu, Iacopo Masi, Xiaoming Liu
arxiv-2410-23556.description: Abstract Differences in forgery attributes of images generated in CNN-synthesized and image-editing domains are large, and such differences make a unified image forgery detection and localization (IFDL) challenging. To this end, we present a hierarchical fine-grained formulation for IFDL representation learning. Specifically, we first represent forgery attributes of a manipulated image with multiple labels at different levels.

arxiv-2501-08435.title: Secure Composition of Quantum Key Distribution and Symmetric Key Encryption
arxiv-2501-08435.creator: Kunal Dey, Reihaneh Safavi-Naini
arxiv-2501-08435.description: Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) allows Alice and Bob to share a secret key over an insecure channel with proven information-theoretic security against an adversary whose strategy is bounded only by the laws of physics. Composability-based security proofs of QKD ensure that using the established key with a one-time-pad encryption scheme provides information theoretic secrecy for the message.

arxiv-2504-03989.title: CORTEX-AVD: A Framework for CORner Case Testing and EXploration in Autonomous Vehicle Development
arxiv-2504-03989.creator: Gabriel Kenji Godoy Shimanuki, Alexandre Moreira Nascimento, Lucio Flavio Vismari, João Batista Camargo, Jr., Jorge Rady de Almeida, Jr., Paulo Sergio Cugnasca
arxiv-2504-03989.description: Abstract Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) aim to improve traffic safety and efficiency by reducing human error. However, ensuring AVs reliability and safety is a challenging task when rare, high-risk traffic scenarios are considered. These ’Corner Cases’ (CC) scenarios, such as unexpected vehicle maneuvers or sudden pedestrian crossings, must be safely and reliably dealt by AVs during their operations.

arxiv-2509-17390.title: FGGS-LiDAR: Ultra-Fast, GPU-Accelerated Simulation from General 3DGS Models to LiDAR
arxiv-2509-17390.creator: Junzhe Wu, Yufei Jia, Yiyi Yan, Zhixing Chen, Tiao Tan, Zifan Wang, Guangyu Wang, BoKui Chen, Guyue Zhou
arxiv-2509-17390.description: Abstract While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has revolutionized photorealistic rendering, its vast ecosystem of assets remains incompatible with high-performance LiDAR simulation, a critical tool for robotics and autonomous driving. We present FGGS-LiDAR , a framework that bridges this gap with a truly plug-and-play approach.

britannica-1911-mons.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mons.description: Article 'Mons' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. small river called the Trouille in the province of Hainaut of which it is the capital. Mons was the capital of the ancient countdom of Hainaut, well known in English history from the marriage of Edward III. with its Countess Philippa. The town was founded by the Countess Waudru in the 8th century, whereupon Charlemagne recognized it as the capital of Hainaut, and it has retained the position ever since.

pmc-11389124.title: Antimicrobial resistance profile and associated factors of hospital-acquired gram-negative bacterial pathogens among hospitalized patients in northeast Ethiopia
pmc-11389124.creator: Mihret Tilahun, Bekele Sharew, Agumas Shibabaw
pmc-11389124.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial resistance is a major global public health issue. Infections caused by resistant species are associated with higher mortality rates, longer hospital stays, medication failure, and rising medical costs. The World Health Organisation has declared multidrug resistance-associated infections as an epidemic of public health concern.

pmc-11647499.title: Association between coronary microvascular dysfunction and exercise capacity in dilated cardiomyopathy
pmc-11647499.creator: Abhishek Dattani, Benjamin A Marrow, Gaurav S Gulsin, Jian L Yeo, Amitha Puranik, Emer M Brady, David Adlam, Anvesha Singh, Mohammedimran M Ansari, Jayanth R Arnold, Hui Xue, Peter Kellman, James S Ware, Gerry P McCann
pmc-11647499.description: BackgroundAerobic exercise capacity is an independent predictor of mortality in dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), but the central mechanisms contributing to exercise intolerance in DCM are unknown. The aim of this study was to characterize coronary microvascular function in DCM and determine if cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) measures are associated with aerobic exercise capacity.

pmc-11714922.title: Associations between neuropsychological tests, plasma biomarkers and PET amyloid scans in a memory clinic cohort
pmc-11714922.creator: Marco Bucci, Ove Almkvist, Marina Bluma, Irina Savitcheva, Mariola Zapater‐Fajari, Konstantinos Chiotis, Anna Matton, Miia Kivipelto, Andreas Jeromin, Guglielmo Di Molfetta, Nicholas J Ashton, Kaj Blennow, Henrik Zetterberg, Agneta K Nordberg
pmc-11714922.description: BackgroundStudies on plasma biomarkers have shown promising results for Alzheimer’s disease(AD) neuropathology in a research setting, but their associations to neuropsychological(NP) tests have not been extensively studied in clinical cohorts. The main aim was to investigate associations between NP, plasma biomarkers and amyloid accumulation in the brain(Aβ‐PET).

pmc-12446453.title: Photonic-electronic arbitrary-waveform generation using quadrature multiplexing and active optical-phase stabilization
pmc-12446453.creator: Christoph Füllner, Alban Sherifaj, Thomas Henauer, Dengyang Fang, Daniel Drayss, Lennart Schmitz, Tobias Harter, Tilahun Z. Gutema, Thomas Zwick, Wolfgang Freude, Sebastian Randel, Christian Koos
pmc-12446453.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Generation of electrical waveforms with bandwidths of 100 GHz or more is key to many applications in science and industry, comprising high-speed communications, radar, or test and measurement equipment. However, while conventional digital-to-analog converters based on electronic circuits still represent the technological mainstay for broadband waveform generation, further bandwidth scaling comes with a series of challenges related to circuit design and implementation, packaging, and system integration. In this paper, we show that photonic-electronic signal-processing techniques may overcome these limitations.

pmc-12450713.title: Global burden and projections of stroke and its subtypes attributable to high alcohol use during 1990–2021: insights from the global burden of disease study 2021
pmc-12450713.creator: Fangfang Zhan, Yifan Chen, Hong Qiu, Yimin Chen, Shuping Lin, Liqiong Zhan, Jun Ni
pmc-12450713.description: BackgroundStroke represents a critical public health challenge with far-reaching global implications for human health. In this study, we seek to characterize the global trends in the burden of stroke attributable to high alcohol use from 1990 to 2021 and investigate its associations with socioeconomic status.

pmc-12501419.description: STUDY QUESTIONIs Life’s Essential 8 (LE8) score associated with sperm quality parameters in healthy reproductive-aged men?SUMMARY ANSWERHigher LE8 score adherence is positively associated with total sperm count, sperm concentration, total motility, and progressive motility.WHAT IS KNOWN ALREADYSeveral lifestyle and cardiovascular risk factors may affect sperm quality, but there is limited scientific evidence in men.

pmc-12593034.title: Postoperative adrenal cortical insufficiency following adrenal adenoma removal: a case report
pmc-12593034.creator: Nanjun Duan, Haidong Yang, Jing Luo, Wenli Yang, Haifeng Wang, Weiran Zhang, Haole Xu
pmc-12593034.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe adrenal gland is one of the important endocrine organs in the human body. With advancements in medical technology, the diagnosis rates of adrenal diseases, such as adrenal tumors and adrenal cortical hyperplasia, have been steadily increasing. Surgical intervention is the mainstream method for treating adrenal tumors; however, unilateral complete adrenalectomy may impair the patient’s adrenal cortical function, leading to adrenal insufficiency (AI).

pmc-12640112.title: Dupilumab-Induced Psoriasis in a Patient With Chronic Rhinosinusitis With Nasal Polyps: A Case Report
pmc-12640112.creator: Rehab Simsim, Jeffery Cowger, Leigh Sowerby
pmc-12640112.description: Dupilumab, an IL-4Rα antagonist, has shown substantial efficacy in the treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP). However, paradoxical dermatologic side effects, including new-onset psoriasis, have recently been reported. We describe a 42-year-old woman with CRSwNP who developed psoriatic skin lesions after initiating dupilumab, despite no personal or family history of psoriasis. She was started on roflumilast 0.

pmc-13117615.title: Evidence That Oscillations in Glucose Metabolism Promote Optimal Islet Function
pmc-13117615.creator: Brian P. List, Nicholas B. Whitticar, Kathryn L. Corbin, Craig S. Nunemaker
pmc-13117615.description: Background/Objectives: Impairment in pulsatile insulin release contributes to insulin resistance and is one of the earliest markers of developing type 2 diabetes. Insulin delivered to the liver in pulses has a stronger glucose-lowering effect than continuous insulin delivery. Whether pulsatility benefits the islet itself is an open question.

pmc-13223969.title: Differentiation of arterioles and capillaries in human blood vessel organoids with decellularized splenic matrix
pmc-13223969.creator: Feiyang Zheng, Yinan Chen, Guangming Xue, Jianhua Xu, Zijun Wang, Guanyuan Yang, Ge Liu, Miao Lei, Panke Cheng, Yansha Hao, Jingting Zhou, Hong Cao, Zhongliang Qin, Youqian Xu, Zheng Yu, Gang Li, Ju Tan, Liang Gong, Dayu Sun, Chuhong Zhu
pmc-13223969.description: Vascular organoids show great promise for promoting angiogenesis post-myocardial infarction, but current organoid culture methods only form capillaries in vitro, while relying on Matrigel faces challenges due to its undefined composition and potential immune reactions, which hinder clinical translation. To address this issue, a splenic extracellular matrix-derived thermoresponsive hydrogel (SpGel) with type I collagen was developed.

pmc-13359116.title: Piperacillin/Tazobactam‐Induced Bilateral Optic Disc Edema With Serous Retinal Fluid in a Young Female With Pelvic Abscess and Sepsis
pmc-13359116.creator: Georgios Papaetis, Ioannis Kazakos, Eleftheria Lazarou, Pantelis Kountourakis, Charis Antoniou, Konstantinos Mikellidis, Priya Gusain
pmc-13359116.description: IntroductionThe typical visual symptoms of optic disc edema are transient visual obscurations due to fluctuations of the optic nerve head blood perfusion. If it remains untreated, it can cause damage and significant vision loss. Piperacillin/tazobactam (PIP/TAZ) exerts broad activity against most gram‐positive and gram‐negative aerobic and anaerobic bacteria, including many pathogens producing beta‐lactamases.

pmc-13673137.title: Chios Mastic in Well‐Controlled Hypertension: Findings From the HYPER‐MASTIC Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13673137.creator: Ioanna Panagiota Kalafati, Anastasia‐Areti Kyriazopoulou‐Korovesi, Evangelia Mentsiou‐Nikolaou, Maria Papaioannou, Christina Konstantaki, Lasthenis Angelidakis, Despoina D Gianniou, Eleni V Mikropoulou, Panagiota Giardoglou, Dimitrios Valakos, Giannis Vatsellas, HYPER‐MASTIC Consortium, Ioanna Andre
pmc-13673137.description: Residual cardiovascular risk persists in patients with adequately controlled hypertension, driven partly by inflammation, oxidative stress and endothelial dysfunction. Chios mastic ( Pistacia lentiscus var. Chia) has shown antihypertensive, antioxidant and vascular effects in experimental and clinical settings. This trial evaluated whether Chios mastic supplementation confers additional cardiovascular benefits in well‐controlled hypertensive individuals.

uslaw-usc-t36-s31110.title: 36 U.S.C. § 31110 — Liability for acts of officers and agents
uslaw-usc-t36-s31110.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s31110.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 311 (Boys & Girls Clubs Of America). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The corporation is liable for the acts of its officers and agents acting within the scope of their authority.

uslaw-usc-t7-s361d.title: 7 U.S.C. § 361d — Use of funds
uslaw-usc-t7-s361d.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s361d.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 14 (Agricultural Experiment Stations); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Moneys appropriated pursuant to sections 361a to 361i of this title shall also be available, in addition to meeting expenses for research and investigations conducted under authority of section 361b of this title, for printing and disseminating the results of such research.
